# Jupiter Wisdom Tales (Tales of Jupiter Wisdom) — Complete Project Specification (llms-full.txt)

> Official Global Storefront, Interactive Reading Room & KYB Verification Portal (`https://jupiter-wisdom-tales.com` / `https://jupitergroop.github.io/jupiter-wisdom-tales/`).
> Author & Series Creator: **Zinaida Jupiter, Doctor of Business Administration (DBA)**, Winner of the *“Leaders of Russia”* National Executive Competition.
> Official Publisher & Merchant of Record: **Limited Liability Company “Jupiter Group”** (*OsOO “Jupiter Group” / Jupiter Group LLC*), Kyrgyz Republic.

## 1. Core Philosophy & Strategic Formula
“Building skills helps a person walk the path with confidence, while strategy answers the most important question: where to walk. That is what we do through classic folk tales.”
*Jupiter Wisdom Tales* unites centuries-old woodland, European, and classical folk parables in museum-grade illustrated editions with warm family character education (Ages 6+) and 2×2 executive decision matrices (Ages 12+, where ★ Quadrant 4 in the upper-right corner represents the constructive leader’s choice).

## 2. About the Author & 18-Expert Editorial Council
- **Zinaida Jupiter, DBA:** Winner of the *“Leaders of Russia”* competition; Founder of **Jupiter Group LLC** and the **InKadr Educational Agency** (individual educational and career pathways into top universities in Russia, China, and BRICS countries).
- **Executive & AI Track Record:** Architect of a proprietary AI management and learning platform; leader of an executive AI implementation program for a leadership team managing over 1 trillion RUB in assets; former Advisor to the Russian Red Cross, where she built an income-generating system from scratch across 51 regions to 103M RUB in annual revenue in year one.
- **Family Tradition:** The series grew out of evening reading and strategic conversations with her children: her son Sergey studies at the Faculty of Physics of Lomonosov Moscow State University, and her daughter Diana studies at the joint MSU-BIT University in Shenzhen, China.
- **18-Expert Editorial Council:** Every book passes a three-tier review across child psychology & philology, DBA executive strategy & negotiation, and museum-grade illustration & fine bookbinding.

## 3. “One Story — 4 Formats” Publishing Architecture
1. **Family Read-Aloud Edition (Ages 6+, 13 pages PDF / Print, $14.99 / $29.99 USD):** 5 pages of illustrated storytelling with 5 framed paintings, 2 pages of heart-to-heart questions and the “Three Roads A, B, C” choice game, and 2 pages of warm parental reflections.
2. **Adult & Leadership Edition (Ages 12+, 13 pages PDF / Print, $14.99 / $29.99 USD):** Complete fable with all proverbs + 6 pages of practical analysis, 2×2 Decision Matrix (Axis Y & Axis X with ★ Quadrant 4), 3 implementation steps, and negotiation idioms.
3. **Collector’s “Golden Tome” Hardcover Folio (84–108 pages, $149.00 USD):** Smyth-sewn hardcover with cloth spine, 3D relief gold foil stamping, 157 gsm parchment-toned paper, and silk ribbon marker.
4. **Full-Cast Audio Drama (15–18 minutes) & Interactive Reading Room:** Multi-voice dramatization + conversational reflection, plus online reading room access for all 16 fables.
